# Peerlist

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Professional-network marketing and signed-out app chrome: white page, Geist UI, Instrument headlines, green rgb(0 170 69) primary with a darker green border, 12px buttons, 16px cards, a 568px marketing column.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed out (public marketing, jobs, scroll, launchpad, search, login, and signup; signup was not submitted). Themes: light.

Public signed-out surfaces of [peerlist.io](https://peerlist.io/), captured on 18 November 2026 from the T3 preview browser. No account was signed in. The live `html` class stayed `light` on home, login, signup, jobs, scroll, launchpad, and search. Desktop readings are from a 1440 by 900 CSS viewport at device pixel ratio 2.

## Typography

11 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Geist, instrument.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Geist is the UI face. Instrument is the display face on the home and auth headlines. Geist Mono is declared and was not used on a measured control. Roboto is the Google button face. The tokens fall back to system faces because the webfont files were not saved.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

There are no screenshots. `preview_snapshot` returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames". Do not treat this package as visual evidence of layout. The dark semantic set is declared, not observed. Toastify colours in the stylesheet were left out because no toast was on screen. Body text computed to `rgb(0, 0, 0)` while `text-gray-1k` is `rgb(13, 13, 13)`. Both are recorded.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the green only for the primary action.** Create Profile is `rgb(0 170 69)` with a `rgb(30 135 75)` border.
- **Keep the page white and the type in Geist.** Display lines use Instrument at 40px or 48px.
- **Round controls at 12px and cards at 16px.** Nav links use 24px. Pills and avatars are full circles.
- **Do not invent a dark screenshot.** The dark tokens are stylesheet declarations.
